e.title: IAI（印度精算师学会）：ACET 入学考试、会员统计与年报
e.title_en: IAI (Institute of Actuaries of India): the ACET entrance examination, membership statistics and annual reports
e.title_hk: IAI（印度精算師學會）：ACET 入學考試、會員統計與年報
e.summary: 印度精算专业团体：自设 ACET 入学考试与考期安排、公开会员统计与年报，是印度精算资格路径的官方入口
e.summary_en: India’s actuarial professional body: its own ACET entrance examination with published dates, plus public membership statistics and annual reports — the official entry to India’s actuarial qualification pathway
e.summary_hk: 印度精算專業團體：自設 ACET 入學考試與考期安排、公開會員統計與年報，是印度精算資格路徑的官方入口
e.body:
**IAI（Institute of Actuaries of India，印度精算师学会）** 是**印度的精算专业团体**，负责印度的精算资格体系。本条目属本轮**亚洲资格路径**取向——实测池内**印度精算师学会本身相关条目为 0**（池内印度侧此前只有监管与市场类条目，如 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]，以及 [[aiai-designation]]——**后者是美国的 The Institutes 认证，与印度 IAI 无关**，容易混淆故在此点明）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **109.7KB**，页面标题实测为 **「Home | Institute of Actuaries of India」**；⭐ **入学考试体系**：实测含 **ACET（Actuarial Common Entrance Test）** 入口与说明页 **`/about-acet`（76.6KB）**、**`/acet-exam-structure`（考试结构）**、**`/examination-dates-1`（考期）**，以及与会员系统打通的 **ACET SignUp / Login**（`member.actuariesindia.org/acetstudents`）；⭐ **会员统计页 `/membership-statistic`（77.2KB）**（带 `field_as_on_target_id` 参数，即**按统计基准日查询**）；**Annual Report（年报）** 页；另有 **Meet Some Of Our Members**、**Annual Membership** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「印度精算资格路径」这一形态**——池内专业团体条目已覆盖英国（[[ifoa]]）、南非（[[assa]]）、法国（[[institut-des-actuaires]]）、西班牙（[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]）、新加坡（[[singapore-actuarial-society]]）、中国（[[china-actuarial-association]]），**印度此前为零**；而印度的特色是**自设入学考试 ACET**（而非直接对接 IFoA/SoA 体系），这与 ASSA 的「与 IFoA 联考」形成**两种路径模式的对照**——对考虑**多体系报考或免考评估**的学生有直接参考价值。**② 会员统计是可用的实证材料**——**按基准日公开会员数**（含不同会员类别）可用于分析**新兴市场精算职业的规模与增长**，这类数据在多数国家并不公开，可与 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]、[[actuarial-outpost]]、[[actubase]]、[[graduate-hiring-model-breakdown]] 一类职业市场条目并读。**③ 与印度监管/市场条目配套**——[[irdai-market-statistics]]（市场统计）、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]（保险业监管报告）加上 IAI（**人才供给侧**），构成**「监管 → 市场 → 人才」**的印度三件套。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、导航结构（含 ACET 相关页面与会员统计页的具体路径）**，**但未打开任何年报、未查询会员统计的具体数值**，因此**不能提供印度的会员人数与增长数据**；**②** 考试与会员制度的**具体规则（费用、资格、免考）以官方最新公告为准，本词条不转述条款**；**③** 站点为**专业团体官网**，**不提供精算软件或市场数据**；**④** 印度精算资格体系的**国际互认关系本次未核实**。**核实说明**：首页（109.7KB）、`/about-acet`（76.6KB）、`/membership-statistic`（77.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开年报、未查询会员数值**。
e.body_en:
**IAI (Institute of Actuaries of India)** is **India’s actuarial professional body**, responsible for the country’s actuarial qualification system. This entry follows this round’s **Asian qualification-pathway** direction — a measured search found **zero entries for the Institute itself** (the corpus’s India side previously held regulatory and market items such as [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] and [[irdai-ai-governance]], plus [[aiai-designation]] — **which is a US "The Institutes" credential unrelated to India’s IAI**, a confusion worth flagging here).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **109.7KB** with the **measured title "Home | Institute of Actuaries of India"**; ⭐ the **entrance examination system** shows an **ACET (Actuarial Common Entrance Test)** entry with an explanatory page **`/about-acet` (76.6KB)**, **`/acet-exam-structure`** and **`/examination-dates-1`**, plus **ACET SignUp / Login** wired to the member system (`member.actuariesindia.org/acetstudents`); ⭐ a **membership statistics page `/membership-statistic` (77.2KB)** (parameterised by `field_as_on_target_id`, i.e. **queryable as of a given reference date**); an **Annual Report** page; and entries such as **Meet Some Of Our Members** and **Annual Membership**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "Indian actuarial qualification pathway" form** — professional-body entries already cover the UK ([[ifoa]]), South Africa ([[assa]]), France ([[institut-des-actuaires]]), Spain ([[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]), Singapore ([[singapore-actuarial-society]]) and China ([[china-actuarial-association]]), while **India was at zero**; India’s distinctive feature is **its own entrance examination, ACET** (rather than direct alignment with the IFoA/SoA systems), which contrasts with ASSA’s **IFoA-coordinated examinations** — **two pathway models side by side**, directly useful for students weighing **multi-system qualification or exemption assessment**. **② The membership statistics are usable evidence** — **membership counts published as of a reference date** (across member categories) support analysis of **the size and growth of the actuarial profession in an emerging market**, data that most countries do not publish, and can be read with career-market entries such as [[asia-actuarial-job-market]], [[actuarial-outpost]], [[actubase]] and [[graduate-hiring-model-breakdown]]. **③ It completes an Indian trio** — [[irdai-market-statistics]] (market data), [[irdai-ai-governance]] and [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] (regulation) plus the IAI (**talent supply**) give a **regulation → market → talent** chain.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles and navigation structure (including the specific ACET and membership-statistics paths)**, **but opened no annual report and queried no membership figures**, so **no Indian membership count or growth rate is provided**; **② the detailed rules of the examinations and membership (fees, eligibility, exemptions) are governed by the latest official notices, and this entry restates no terms**; **③** this is a **professional body site and offers no actuarial software or market data**; **④** the **international mutual-recognition relationships of India’s qualification system were not verified**. **Verification note**: the homepage (109.7KB), `/about-acet` (76.6KB) and `/membership-statistic` (77.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no annual report was opened and no membership figures were queried**.
e.body_hk:
**IAI（Institute of Actuaries of India，印度精算師學會）** 是**印度的精算專業團體**。本條目屬本輪**亞洲資格路徑**取向——實測池內**印度精算師學會本身相關條目為 0**（池內印度側此前只有監管與市場類條目，以及 [[aiai-designation]]——**後者是美國 The Institutes 認證，與印度 IAI 無關**，容易混淆故在此點明）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **109.7KB**，標題實測為 **「Home | Institute of Actuaries of India」**；⭐ **入學考試體系**：實測含 **ACET** 入口與說明頁 **`/about-acet`（76.6KB）**、**考結構頁**、**考期頁**，以及與會員系統打通的 **ACET SignUp／Login**；⭐ **會員統計頁（77.2KB）**（帶統計基準日參數）；**年報**頁；另有 **Meet Some Of Our Members** 等入口。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「印度精算資格路徑」這一形態**——池內專業團體已覆蓋英、南非、法、西、新加坡、中國，**印度此前為零**；印度特色是**自設入學考試 ACET**，與 ASSA 的「與 IFoA 聯考」形成**兩種路徑模式對照**；**② 會員統計是可用的實證材料**（**按基準日公開會員數**），可用於分析**新興市場精算職業規模與增長**；**③ 與 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] 構成「監管 → 市場 → 人才」印度三件套**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題與導航結構**，**但未打開年報、未查詢會員數值**，**故不提供印度會員人數與增長數據**；**② 考試與會員制度細則以官方最新公告為準，本詞條不轉述條款**；**③** 本站為**專業團體官網，不提供精算軟件或市場數據**；**④ 國際互認關係未核實**。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開年報、未查詢會員數值**。
